newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut's Byblos Bank in $50 mln Euronote issue.
newsitem.headline: Beirut's Byblos Bank in $50 mln Euronote issue.

text.p: SBC Warburg and Beirut finance house Lebanon Invest SAL announced on Friday the issue of a $50 million three-year Euronote for Byblos Bank of Beirut.
The notes will be listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange and priced to yield around 300 basis points over comparable U.S. Treasury notes, Lebanon Invest said in a statement.
Road shows will be held in Geneva on September 4 and in London on September 5. The official launch will be on September 9, the statement said.
"This Euronote issue represents the first of its kind for a Lebanese commercial bank," it said.
